App details

Unit Converter

Convert everyday and technical units, with useful calculators and quick access to your favorites.

Coming soonIn developmentAndroid

What it’s for

Use Unit Converter when a recipe, measurement or technical task uses unfamiliar units. Enter a value once to see related results. Useful calculators cover density, data-transfer time, dilution, energy costs, lighting and concentration.

Main features

  • Length, temperature, mass, speed and more.
  • Several conversion results from one value.
  • Search, favorites and recent calculations.
  • Offline calculations without an account.

The app is being tested. See Availability below for its current download status.

Features in detail

Common

Choose a conversion below and enter a value in any unit’s row. All other results update together; any row can be your starting point.

Length

Compare lengths and distances, such as furniture dimensions in centimetres and inches.

Supported units: nm, µm, mm, cm, m, km, in, ft, yd, mi, nmi

Mass

Convert mass values, such as a parcel labelled in kilograms or pounds.

Supported units: µg, mg, g, kg, t, oz, lb, st, ct

Area

Compare surface or land areas, from square metres to hectares, acres and the Hungarian négyszögöl.

Supported units: mm², cm², m², km², in², ft², yd², ha, acre, öl²

Volume

Convert liquid or solid volumes. US and Imperial gallons, pints and fluid ounces remain separate; cups and spoons use US measures.

Supported units: mL, cL, dL, L, cm³, dm³, m³, US fl oz, imp fl oz, US cup, US pt, imp pt, US gal, imp gal, US tsp, US tbsp

Speed

Convert travel or flow speeds, for example km/h to m/s. A knot means one nautical mile per hour.

Supported units: cm/s, m/s, km/h, mph, knot, ft/s

Temperature

Compare Celsius, Fahrenheit, Kelvin and Rankine temperatures. Values below absolute zero produce an error.

Supported units: °C, °F, K, °R

Time

Convert fixed durations from nanoseconds to weeks, for example minutes into hours and seconds.

Supported units: ns, µs, ms, s, min, h, d, wk

Fuel consumption

Compare litres per 100 km, kilometres per litre and miles per US or Imperial gallon. Reciprocal conversions require a positive input.

Supported units: L/100 km, km/L, mpg (US), mpg (Imp)

Engineering

Choose a conversion below and enter a value in any unit’s row. All other results update together; any row can be your starting point.

Plane angle

Convert angles for drawings or rotations, using degrees, radians, revolutions, arcminutes or arcseconds.

Supported units: °, rad, mrad, gon, rev, arcmin (′), arcsec (″)

Pressure

Compare pressure readings expressed in bar, psi, pascals or millimetres of mercury, among other units.

Supported units: Pa, hPa, kPa, MPa, bar, mbar, atm, psi, mmHg, Torr, inHg, mmH₂O, inH₂O, kgf/cm²

Force

Convert pushing or pulling forces in newtons, kilogram-force or pound-force. These are force values, not masses.

Supported units: N, kN, gf, kgf, ozf, lbf

Torque

Convert torque values, such as tightening instructions in N·m and lbf·ft.

Supported units: N·cm, N·m, kN·m, kgf·cm, ozf·in, lbf·in, lbf·ft

Frequency

Express how often an event repeats each second in hertz and its multiples.

Supported units: Hz, kHz, MHz, GHz, THz

Mass density

Convert a material’s known mass per volume, for example g/cm³ to kg/m³. This converter takes density directly.

Supported units: kg/m³, kg/L, g/cm³, g/mL, lb/ft³, lb/in³

Specific volume

Convert the volume occupied per unit of mass, for example the space occupied by one kilogram of material.

Supported units: m³/kg, L/kg, cm³/g, ft³/lb, in³/lb

Mass moment of inertia

Convert a known value describing resistance to rotational acceleration. No shape or mass distribution is calculated.

Supported units: kg·m², kg·cm², g·cm², lb·ft², lb·in²

Heat capacity

Convert the energy needed to raise the temperature of a whole object by one degree.

Supported units: J/K, J/°C, kJ/K, cal/°C, Btu/°F

Cooling capacity

Compare a cooling appliance’s capacity in watts, Btu/h or refrigeration tons.

Supported units: W, kW, Btu/h, kcal/h, TR

Angular velocity

Convert rotation rates, for example revolutions per minute into radians per second.

Supported units: °/s, rad/s, rev/s, rpm

Angular acceleration

Convert the rate at which rotational speed changes, in degrees, radians or revolutions per second squared.

Supported units: °/s², rad/s², rev/s²

Density / mass / volume

Choose density, mass or volume to find, then enter the other two values with their units. For example, 1000 kg/m³ and 1 L give 1 kg. It assumes a uniform material; you supply its density.

Electrical

Choose a conversion below and enter a value in any unit’s row. All other results update together; any row can be your starting point.

Electric potential

Convert voltage readings from microvolts to kilovolts, for example component or power-supply specifications.

Supported units: µV, mV, V, kV

Electric current

Convert electrical currents from nanoamps to kiloamps, for example mA into A.

Supported units: nA, µA, mA, A, kA

Resistance

Compare resistor values in milliohms, ohms and larger units when reading component specifications.

Supported units: mΩ, Ω, kΩ, MΩ, GΩ

Conductance

Convert conductance, the reciprocal of resistance, in siemens and its smaller units.

Supported units: nS, µS, mS, S

Capacitance

Compare a capacitor’s capacitance in pF, nF, µF, mF and F.

Supported units: pF, nF, µF, mF, F

Inductance

Convert a coil’s inductance between nH, µH, mH and H.

Supported units: nH, µH, mH, H

Power

Compare watts, mechanical horsepower, metric horsepower, Btu/h, dBW and dBm. The horsepower definitions differ; logarithmic levels require positive power.

Supported units: mW, W, kW, MW, GW, hp (mechanical), PS/LE (metric), Btu/h, dBW, dBm

Energy

Compare energy in joules, watt-hours, kilowatt-hours, calories and Btu, for consumption or heat-energy figures.

Supported units: J, kJ, MJ, GJ, Wh, kWh, MWh, Btu_IT, cal, kcal

Electrical resistivity

Convert a material’s resistivity, rather than the total resistance of a finished wire.

Supported units: Ω·m, Ω·mm²/m, Ω·cm, µΩ·cm

Electrical conductivity

Compare a material’s electrical conductivity in siemens per metre or centimetre and their multiples.

Supported units: µS/m, mS/m, S/m, MS/m, µS/cm, mS/cm, S/cm

Electric charge

Compare charge in coulombs and amp-hours, including mAh and Ah. This alone does not calculate battery energy.

Supported units: nC, µC, mC, C, kC, mAh, Ah

Current density

Convert current per unit of area, for example A/mm² into A/m².

Supported units: A/m², A/mm², A/cm², mA/cm², A/in²

Linear charge density

Convert electrical charge per unit of length, for example data describing a charged conductor.

Supported units: nC/m, µC/m, mC/m, C/m

Surface charge density

Convert electrical charge per unit of surface area, including square-centimetre and square-metre measures.

Supported units: nC/m², µC/m², mC/m², C/m², µC/cm²

Volume charge density

Convert electrical charge per unit of volume, using coulombs and smaller charge units per cubic metre.

Supported units: nC/m³, µC/m³, mC/m³, C/m³

Electric field strength

Compare electric field strength in volts per metre, its multiples and newtons per coulomb.

Supported units: mV/m, V/m, kV/m, MV/m, N/C

Permittivity

Convert permittivity, which describes a material’s response to an electric field, in farads per metre and smaller units.

Supported units: pF/m, nF/m, F/m

Energy consumption / cost

Enter power and usage time: 2 kW for three hours consumes 6 kWh. For cost, also enter your price per kWh and currency label. Without a price it shows energy only; no tariff or exchange rate is fetched.

Fluids

Choose a conversion below and enter a value in any unit’s row. All other results update together; any row can be your starting point.

Dynamic viscosity

Compare dynamic viscosity, describing a liquid’s internal friction, in Pa·s and poise units.

Supported units: µPa·s, mPa·s, Pa·s, cP, P

Kinematic viscosity

Convert kinematic viscosity in m²/s and stokes units. It is a different quantity from dynamic viscosity.

Supported units: mm²/s, m²/s, cSt, St

Volume flow rate

Convert the volume flowing per unit of time, for example L/min, m³/h or US gallons per minute.

Supported units: L/min, L/s, m³/h, m³/s, GPM (US), CFM

Amount concentration

Compare molarity, the amount of substance per volume of solution, in mol/L and mol/m³ with their smaller units.

Supported units: µmol/L, mmol/L, mol/L, mol/m³

Mass concentration

Convert the mass of dissolved material per volume, for example mg/L into g/m³.

Supported units: µg/L, mg/L, g/L, µg/m³, mg/m³, g/m³

Dimensionless ratio

Convert ratios on the same basis between percent, per mille, ppm (parts per million) and ppb (parts per billion).

Supported units: %, ‰, ppm, ppb

Intrinsic permeability

Convert a known value of a porous material’s permeability in m², µm², darcy and millidarcy.

Supported units: m², µm², D, mD

Surface tension

Compare liquid surface-tension readings in N/m, mN/m and dyn/cm.

Supported units: N/m, mN/m, dyn/cm

Water hardness

Compare water hardness expressed as CaCO₃ concentration, mmol/L or German, French and English hardness degrees.

Supported units: mg/L CaCO₃, ppm CaCO₃, mmol/L, °dH, °fH, °eH

Dilution

Choose molar concentration, mass concentration or volume ratio. Enter three of the two concentrations and two volumes to find the fourth and the diluent volume. 100 mL at 1 mol/L diluted to 0.5 mol/L needs 200 mL final volume, including 100 mL diluent. It assumes the same substance and additive volumes.

Molarity / mass concentration

Choose molarity to mass concentration or the reverse. Enter concentration and the same substance’s molar mass in g/mol. For example, 1 mol/L and 58.44 g/mol give 58.44 g/L. You provide the substance’s molar mass.

Thermal

Choose a conversion below and enter a value in any unit’s row. All other results update together; any row can be your starting point.

Specific heat capacity

Convert energy needed to raise one unit of mass by one degree, for example J/(kg·K) into cal/(g·°C).

Supported units: J/(g·K), J/(kg·K), kJ/(kg·K), cal/(g·°C), Btu/(lb·°F)

Heat flux density

Compare heat power transferred per unit of area, for example W/m² and Btu/(h·ft²).

Supported units: W/m², kW/m², W/cm², Btu/(h·ft²)

Thermal conductivity

Compare a material’s ability to conduct heat using metric and Imperial conductivity units.

Supported units: mW/(m·K), W/(m·K), W/(m·°C), Btu/(h·ft·°F)

Heat transfer coefficient

Convert the coefficient describing heat transfer between a surface and its surroundings.

Supported units: W/(m²·K), W/(m²·°C), Btu/(h·ft²·°F)

Optics

Choose a conversion below and enter a value in any unit’s row. All other results update together; any row can be your starting point.

Luminous intensity

Convert light intensity emitted in one direction between millicandelas and candelas.

Supported units: mcd, cd

Illuminance

Compare light arriving at a surface in lux, kilolux and foot-candles.

Supported units: lx, klx, foot-candle (fc)

Luminance

Convert the brightness of a surface viewed from one direction between cd/m² (also called nit) and foot-lamberts.

Supported units: cd/m² (nit), foot-lambert (fL)

Lighting

Choose luminous flux in lumens, illuminance in lux or area as the unknown and enter the other two. For example, 1000 lm over 10 m² gives 100 lx. The estimate assumes uniform light distribution without losses.

Magnetism

Choose a conversion below and enter a value in any unit’s row. All other results update together; any row can be your starting point.

Magnetic flux density

Compare magnetic flux density in teslas, gauss and smaller tesla units.

Supported units: nT, µT, mT, T, G

Magnetic field strength

Compare magnetic field strength in A/m, kA/m and oersteds.

Supported units: A/m, kA/m, Oe

Magnetic flux

Convert magnetic flux, the magnetic field passing through a surface, between webers and maxwells.

Supported units: µWb, mWb, Wb, Mx

Magnetic permeability

Convert magnetic permeability, describing how a material supports a magnetic field, in H/m and smaller units.

Supported units: µH/m, mH/m, H/m

Computing

Choose a conversion below and enter a value in any unit’s row. All other results update together; any row can be your starting point.

Data amount

Compare file sizes and stored data. One byte is eight bits. kB/MB/GB use steps of 1000; KiB/MiB/GiB use 1024.

Supported units: bit, kbit, Mbit, Gbit, Tbit, Byte, kB, MB, GB, TB, PB, KiB, MiB, GiB, TiB, PiB

Data rate

Convert data rates between bits per second, bytes per second, and their decimal or binary multiples.

Supported units: bit/s, kbit/s, Mbit/s, Gbit/s, Tbit/s, Byte/s, kB/s, MB/s, GB/s, TB/s, KiB/s, MiB/s, GiB/s

Pixel count

Express a pixel count in pixels, kilopixels, megapixels or gigapixels. This changes the count’s unit, not an image file’s size.

Supported units: px, kpx, Mpx, Gpx

Data transfer time

Enter the data amount and useful transfer rate to estimate duration: 1 GB at 100 Mbit/s takes 80 s. It assumes constant speed without network overhead or interruptions.

Number base converter

Choose binary, octal, decimal or hexadecimal and enter a signed integer. Other forms appear together: DEC 255 = HEX FF = OCT 377 = BIN 11111111. Fractions, 0x/0b prefixes and two’s-complement notation are not accepted.

Radiology

Choose a conversion below and enter a value in any unit’s row. All other results update together; any row can be your starting point. Only unit conversions are provided; no diagnosis, treatment or radiation-protection decision is made.

Absorbed dose

Convert absorbed radiation dose between gray and rad, including the listed smaller units.

Supported units: µGy, mGy, Gy, rad

Radionuclide activity

Convert radioactive activity, the number of decays per unit of time, between becquerels and curies.

Supported units: Bq, kBq, MBq, GBq, TBq, µCi, mCi, Ci

Radiation exposure

Convert radiation exposure readings between C/kg and roentgen units.

Supported units: mC/kg, C/kg, mR, R

Dose equivalent

Convert radiation-protection dose units between sieverts and rem. No biological weighting or gray-to-sievert calculation is performed.

Supported units: µSv, mSv, Sv, mrem, rem

Astronomy

Choose a conversion below and enter a value in any unit’s row. All other results update together; any row can be your starting point.

Astronomical distance

Compare astronomical distances in kilometres, astronomical units, light-years and parsecs.

Supported units: km, AU, ly, pc, kpc, Mpc, Gpc

Astronomical mass

Express mass in kilograms or in Earth, Jupiter and solar masses.

Supported units: kg, M⊕, M♃, M☉

Luminosity

Compare a star’s total emitted power in watts and solar luminosities. This is not its apparent brightness from Earth.

Supported units: W, L☉

Sizes

These advisory size comparisons help when shopping. Select a supported size and check the manufacturer’s own chart too.

Shoe size

Choose a supported EU, UK, US men’s/women’s, JP/cm or foot-length-in-mm size. Other fields show advisory equivalents; intermediate values may show two neighbouring choices. Brands can differ.

Supported units: Mondopoint, EU, UK, US Men's, US Women's, JP/cm

Women clothing size

Choose a women’s EU, UK, US or international size. Other systems show a size or range. Equivalences are advisory and depend on brand and garment type.

Supported units: EU, UK, US, International

Men clothing size

Choose tops or trousers and a supported men’s size. Tops show a shared letter size and advisory chest measurements; trousers show EU, UK/US waist and international equivalents. Brands can differ.

Supported units: EU, UK, US, International

Quick access, settings and everyday use

Using simultaneous results

Choose a function and edit any unit’s row. Other results update immediately: 1 m becomes 100 cm and about 3.28 ft together. Invalid or incomplete input does not show an old result as current.

Search

Search by category, function, unit name, symbol or familiar synonym. Searching lux can find both the illuminance converter and lighting calculator. Open a result to reach its function.

Favorites and recent functions

Use the star in the catalog or recent list to save a favorite function, then arrange favorites in your own order. Recent lists the last ten different functions opened; it does not store previous calculation inputs.

History and saved input

Up to fifty calculations stay locally. Reopen one to restore its function and input with freshly calculated results. Delete one or all history entries without deleting favorites. Clearing the current input is separate.

Copying results

Copy a labelled value with its row’s copy icon, or copy the complete result list together for a note or message. Size comparisons include their advisory warning in the copied text.

Mini calculator

The calculator icon opens a separate panel for +, −, × and ÷. Multiplication and division come first: 2 + 3 × 4 = 14. Use decimal point or comma, backspace and clear; parentheses are not supported. Paste one valid number or a single UC numeric result, not a whole results list. Copy the answer explicitly; it does not overwrite converter input.

Language and number display

Choose one of eight app languages. Use automatic precision or 0–10 fixed decimal places, scientific notation and optional thousands grouping. Very small nonzero values use scientific notation when needed. Changing display settings does not change calculation input.

Offline use and local data

All 77 functions work without internet or a user account. Favorites, history and settings stay on the device. Calculations need no camera, microphone, location or contacts access. Android 7.0 or newer is required.

Ads and one-time ad removal

Every function is free. Banner ads can appear and a one-time Google Play purchase removes them. Play shows the current price; purchase restoration is available. Ads, consent choices and purchase checks may need internet. Voluntary support is separate and does not remove ads.

About dedication

Tap the About logo seven times to open an offline dedication to Adorján, with a message about imagination and possibilities. Close the message to return; it changes no calculation or setting.

Availability

The app is in internal Google Play testing, including active ads and optional ad removal. There is no verified public production download yet.
